match_poses_greedy: match estimated 6DoF poses to ground-truth poses using greedy matching by decreasing confidence score
match_poses_scene: match estimated poses to ground-truth poses across all images in a single scene with per-object evaluation
match_poses_with_threshold: match poses using multi-element error thresholds like ADD or 5deg 5cm metrics
match_poses_top_k: match only the top k highest-scoring pose estimates to ground-truth poses
match_poses_valid_mask: match poses while filtering ground-truth poses using a validity mask to exclude invalid entries
